sourceTitle: Lives of the English Poets From Johnson to Kirke White, Designed as a Continuation of Johnson's Lives
description: "Lives of the English Poets" by Henry Francis Cary is a biographical compilation written in the mid-19th century. This work is designed as a continuation of Samuel Johnson's earlier lives of poets, focusing on notable English poets from Johnson's time up to Kirke White.
